title: Pipe chart layout reset — flex fit that actually works
description:
Reworked the pipe chart float panel from a fragile CSS subgrid to a simple flex layout: top sphere, pipe track, bottom sphere. The shaft can no longer run past the end caps. Observation tags shrink to the available track height, and a final uniform zoom keeps the whole chart inside the panel without clipping remarks or spheres.

Who is affected: everyone on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Pipe chart float panel rebuilt on flex: shaft stays between From/To spheres.
Observation tags shrink to fit the track height.
Uniform zoom keeps the full chart visible with no clipping.
Removed the broken min-height / subgrid fit path that made the layout look off.
